notes.title: Reframed Patch : Version 1.1 : "The many" patch...
notes.notes:
Since I've received feedback about game being too difficult, I wanted balance the power of weapons and added more ammo and health packs across all levels.

Currently, both the shotgun and machine gun has 50% more damage and sniper rifle has 25% more damage. We didn't touch the rocket launcher since it was already powerful.

Chapter 1,2,4 and 5 especially received more healthpacks.

That's not the only change, I changed something else :

I added many more enemies to balance the the fact that weapons are more powerful.

The game feels much more action packed at the moment.

So enjoy the current version which has ;

*More power to the weapons
*More ammo
*More healthpacks
*More enemies of all types
*More action

notes.title: ReFramed announced!
notes.notes:
ReFramed takes place in the same universe and timeline as Solarix but reimagined as a fast-paced, combat focused, FPS. Instead of exploring the research station as an engineer sneaking around to survive, you are now an extremely skilled soldier shooting his way to freedom.

Take on the role of the elite soldier fighting for survival after an infection lays siege to an interstellar research station. You must use your extensive training and deadly arsenal of weapons to contain the disease, whilst eliminating what’s left of the infected crew. Relive the original stealth-based Solarix story as an action-packed FPS as you utilise an extensive arsenal of epic weapons, such as Sniper Rifle and Rocket Launcher, all brand new to the Solarix universe.

ReFramed is played to a pulse pounding action soundtrack to keep you pumped as you lay waste to your infected foes and a suspenseful sci-fi horror narrative acts as a backdrop to your ruthless killing mission. Storm through 11 stunningly crafted levels as your highly trained soldier such as Surface of Planet Ancyra, Mines and Remora Space Station. ReFramed is an intense, old school first-person horror shooter with 2000s style graphics and 1990s style retro-gameplay.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KOth8qvUjGQ
